beats.summary: Dwight announces he has left Dunder-Mifflin and is on the job market.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I have left Dunder-Mifflin after many record-breaking years and am officially on the job market.

beats.summary: Andy expresses enthusiasm about working under Jim and tries to bond with him.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Side note. I'd just like to say I'm thrilled to be working directly beneath you.
Andy: I feel I have a lot to learn from you, even though you're younger and have less experience.

evidence.snippet: Michael: But, there is some good news. Oscar is back. Addition by addition.
